name: Facebook Automation & SEO Studio
description: Pre-Trained Phone (Desktop-on-Phone www.facebook.com & Mobile Touch m.facebook.com) and Desktop Facebook Automation Engine (v1.5.0): Dedicated Feed Posts (Text/Photo/Carousel/Video), Reels (/reels/create + mobile fallback), Stories (/stories/create Photo/Video with overlay story_text & Text Story), Real Video/Reel Thumbnail & Cover Uploader, Multiline Formatted Caption Engine (Title + Description + Bullets + CTA + 3-6 #Hashtags), and Zero-Overthinking 1-Call Dispatch.
author: Dipesh Kr Yadav

mcp_tools.name: fb_status
mcp_tools.description: Check Facebook Automation status, automatically open Facebook in the AntiGem browser if not open, and verify one-time login state. NOTE: Do NOT call fb_status before fb_publish—call fb_publish directly in 1 step! If logged_in is false (action_required='ONE_TIME_LOGIN_REQUIRED'), tell the user once to sign in to Facebook in the open AntiGem browser tab and STOP immediately.

open_browser.description: Automatically open Facebook in the AntiGem browser if no Facebook tab is currently open (default: true).

mcp_tools.name: fb_login_status
mcp_tools.description: Open Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/) in the AntiGem browser if not open, verify active login session (cookies + DOM), and persist one-time login state. IMPORTANT: If logged_in is false, Facebook is already open on the login screen in the AntiGem browser—ask the user once for their one-time login and STOP immediately (do not loop).

open_browser.description: Open and focus Facebook in the AntiGem browser if not already open (default: true).

mcp_tools.name: fb_open_browser
mcp_tools.description: Explicitly open and focus Facebook inside the AntiGem browser (feed, reels composer, story creator, or specific page/group) and check one-time login readiness.

view.description: Target Facebook section to open in the AntiGem browser (default: 'feed').

target_id.description: Optional Page ID, Group ID, or custom Facebook URL.

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish
mcp_tools.description: 1-STEP FEED PUBLISHER (Text, Photo, Carousel, Feed Video — also routes Reel/Story if post_type specifies). NOTE: Prefer `fb_publish_reel` for Facebook Reels and `fb_publish_story` for Facebook Stories! ALWAYS include `title`, formatted multiline `caption` (Title -> blank line -> Description/Quote -> Bullets -> CTA, keeping \n\n line breaks), and 3-6 `hashtags`. For Feed Videos (`post_type="video"`), pass `thumbnail_path` and it will be uploaded inside Edit Video -> Thumbnail (NEVER attached as a second feed photo). For Photos (`post_type="photo"`), combine `media_paths` + deep `caption` + `title` + 3-6 `hashtags` in ONE call.

title.description: Scroll-stopping viral Title / Headline for the post, photo, video, or reel (auto-crafted if omitted).

caption.description: Senior Social Media Manager caption combining a deep quote, 2-3 punchy micro-insights, and an engaging question CTA (auto-crafted if omitted or short).

hashtags.description: List of 3-6 targeted hashtags (e.g. ['#Mindset', '#Growth']). Automatically appended to the caption.

media_paths.description: List of file paths to photos or videos (supports /sdcard/..., ~/..., absolute paths, or ['latest'] to automatically attach the newest photo/video on the device).

thumbnail_path.description: Optional path (local or file:// URI) to custom JPG/PNG/WebP thumbnail for Feed Video (`post_type="video"`) or Reel. Uploaded via Edit Video -> Thumbnail / Reel Cover panel (never attached as extra feed photo). If missing for video/reel, ask user to provide one or generate via AI Image Model (`fb_thumbnail_prompt`).

post_type.description: Format of the Facebook upload: 'photo', 'carousel', 'video', 'reel', 'story', or 'text'. Always set 'photo' when uploading a photo!

target_type.description: Where to publish: 'profile' (personal feed), 'page' (managed page), or 'group'.

target_id.description: Optional Page ID/slug or Group ID.

first_comment.description: Optional first comment (e.g. external resource link) to post immediately after publishing.

story_text.description: Short overlay text (<=120 chars) used ONLY when post_type='story' (Stories have no caption/hashtag field).

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish_reel
mcp_tools.description: DEDICATED FACEBOOK REELS PUBLISHER (`https://www.facebook.com/reels/create` + automatic mobile Feed fallback). Use THIS tool whenever the user asks to post/upload a Facebook Reel! Supports `video_path` (local/file:///'latest'), custom cover `thumbnail_path` (applied in the Reel Cover/Thumbnail panel before Publish), `title`, formatted multiline `caption` description (`\n\n` spacing preserved), and 3-6 `hashtags`.

video_path.description: Path to the vertical MP4/MOV video file (supports /sdcard/..., ~/..., absolute paths, or 'latest').

caption.description: Reel caption body with hook, quote, and CTA.

hashtags.description: List of 3-6 targeted hashtags (auto-appended if not already in caption).

thumbnail_path.description: Custom JPG/PNG/WebP cover image uploaded in the Reel Edit/Cover panel. If not provided, ask the user whether to supply one or generate via AI Image Model (`fb_thumbnail_prompt`).

target_id.description: Optional Page ID if publishing to a page.

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish_story
mcp_tools.description: DEDICATED FACEBOOK STORIES PUBLISHER (`https://www.facebook.com/stories/create`). Use THIS tool whenever the user asks to upload a Photo Story, Video Story, or Text Story! Supports `media_path` (image/video or 'latest'; omit for a Text Story) and optional short `story_text` overlay (clicked into 'Add text' -> 'Done', <=120 chars). Note: Stories do NOT have feed captions or hashtags.

media_path.description: Local or file:// path (or 'latest') to photo/video for Photo/Video Story. Omit to publish a Text Story.

story_text.description: Short overlay text (Photo/Video Story 'Add text') or full message for Text Story. Max 120 chars for media overlay.

caption.description: Legacy fallback text if `story_text` is omitted (first line used; Stories do not support feed captions or hashtags).

mcp_tools.name: fb_thumbnail_prompt
mcp_tools.description: Craft an ultra-detailed, creative Master Art Direction prompt for generating a high-CTR clickbait thumbnail using an AI Image Model (Nano Banana Pro / Google Flow / image-generator subagent). STRICT MANDATE: NEVER use Python (PIL/Pillow/OpenCV) to generate thumbnails! Always pass this tool's prompt to the AI Image Model to render the thumbnail.

topic.description: Core topic or subject of the video/reel/post.

title_hook.description: Dominant 2-4 word bold hook text to render in the thumbnail (e.g. 'STOP DOING THIS', 'SECRET REVEALED').

subtitle.description: Short 3-6 word subtitle badge text explaining what it is about.

archetype.description: Creative visual archetype for the AI Image Model (default: 'surreal_metaphor').

aspect_ratio.description: Thumbnail aspect ratio: '9:16' for Reels/Stories, '16:9' for landscape video, '4:5' for feed portrait.

mcp_tools.name: fb_resume_pending
mcp_tools.description: Resume and execute any pending Facebook upload task (post, reel, story, edit, delete, comment) after the user has completed their one-time login in the AntiGem browser.

mcp_tools.name: fb_schedule
mcp_tools.description: Schedule a Facebook post, carousel, video, reel, or story for future publication. Enforces Title + formatted multiline Description + 3-6 #Hashtags for feed/video/reel posts, or clean `story_text` for Stories.

run_at_timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp (seconds) or ISO time when the post should publish.

media_paths.description: List of file paths to media (or ['latest']).

thumbnail_path.description: Optional path to AI-Image-Model-generated or custom thumbnail.

target_id.description: Optional target Page or Group ID.

mcp_tools.name: fb_edit_post
mcp_tools.description: Re-edit an existing Facebook post caption via 3-dots DOM menu automation in the AntiGem browser.

post_url_or_id.description: URL or identifier of the post to edit (or 'latest' for the most recent post on profile).

new_caption.description: New caption text to replace the existing post content.

mcp_tools.name: fb_delete_post
mcp_tools.description: Delete a Facebook post or move it to trash via 3-dots menu automation in the AntiGem browser.

post_url_or_id.description: URL or identifier of the post to delete (or 'latest' for the most recent post).

mcp_tools.name: fb_list_posts
mcp_tools.description: List published, scheduled, awaiting-login, or failed posts from local storage and database.

mcp_tools.name: fb_seo_generate
mcp_tools.description: Generate a complete algorithm-optimized viral Facebook package: Title, 1-line Hook, Deep Quote, 3-4 punchy Micro-Bullets, Engagement CTA, 3-6 targeted Hashtags, Alt-Text, First-Comment Link, AND a detailed AI Image Model Thumbnail Prompt.

topic.description: Core subject or idea of the post.

link_url.description: Optional outbound link to place in first comment.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the AI Image Model thumbnail prompt (default: '9:16' for Reels, '16:9' for Video).

mcp_tools.name: fb_audit_caption
mcp_tools.description: Audit a post caption for Facebook algorithmic penalties (missing title/hook, missing hashtags, outbound links in body, hashtag stuffing, wall-of-text density).

mcp_tools.name: fb_comments
mcp_tools.description: Post a comment (e.g. first comment with external link) or reply on a Facebook post in the AntiGem browser.

post_url_or_id.description: URL or identifier of the target post (or 'latest' for active post).

mcp_tools.name: fb_doctor
mcp_tools.description: Self-diagnose Facebook automation environment, AntiGem browser tab state, one-time login persistence, debugger readiness, and anti-duplicate guardrails.
